_note: A red crab just off a corner of the board, facing its centre, a tile in its right claw, seen from behind as the game's camera sees it. No board model yet: the board is imagined at sand level, its squares 210 mm apart. Square (row r, column c) has its centre at x = (c - 7) * 210, z = (r - 7) * 210 (the centre square is the origin); the corner square (0, 0) is at (-1470, -1470). CRAB lies along row 0 from the corner (read from this side), an S under its A and a see-through E where the held tile would go.
name: Crab at a corner
